newsitem.title: GREECE: EVERT TO RUN FOR NEW DEMOCRACY PRESIDENCY, SOURCES.
newsitem.headline: EVERT TO RUN FOR NEW DEMOCRACY PRESIDENCY, SOURCES.

text.p: Miltiades Evert, who resigned from the helm of the conservative party after Sunday's election defeat, is set to run again for president and will announce his decision early next week, official party sources said.
"He is under presure from many deputies to run again. There are at least 60 signatures collected and the chances are he will announce his candidacy early next week," one source said.
"If he runs he will win. He controls the party and has the backing of most new deputies," the source added.
An Evert candidacy will set the stage for a head on clash with former prime minister Constantine Mitsotakis, whose daughter, Dora Bakoyanni has already announced her candidacy.
Evert wants to move before Mitsotakis has time to rally support for Dora. Mitsotakis now controls about 30 New Democracy deputies from the 108 elected in parliament, sources said.
A feud between Mitsotakis and Evert is threatening to split New Democracy in two following Sunday's defeat to the ruling socialist PASOK party. --Costas Paris, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
